people.name: Leah Park

people.facet: Owen is the cross-group validation partner for metrics, retrieval quality, rollups, and recovery checks. [msg:2101][msg:2111]

concepts.name: Local-first Memory
concepts.scope: How durable local archives become source-attributed memory surfaces.
concepts.summary: Local-first memory keeps durable source material on the user's machine while allowing relationship, project, and reliability views to be rebuilt from cited correspondence. [msg:2005][msg:2041][msg:2091][msg:2109][msg:2114]

concepts.name: Source-aware Writing
concepts.scope: Writing practices that preserve provenance from notes and correspondence.
concepts.summary: Source-aware writing treats citations as part of drafting and synthesis, with researchers, editors, and data collaborators checking interpretation against the underlying thread. [msg:2025][msg:2043][msg:2097][msg:2099][msg:2101]

concepts.name: Relationship Context
concepts.scope: Longitudinal context for understanding collaboration and shared history.
concepts.summary: Relationship context emerges from bidirectional history and from recurring shared threads that reveal who collaborates, who bridges groups, and how responsibilities evolve. [msg:2001][msg:2009][msg:2033][msg:2091][msg:2097][msg:2103][msg:2109]
